newsitem.title: KYRGYZSTAN: Kyrgyz national carrier to fly to Hanover, Sharjah.
newsitem.headline: Kyrgyz national carrier to fly to Hanover, Sharjah.

text.p: Kyrgyzstan's national air carrier Kyrgyzstan Aba Zholdoru is launching regular flights to Hanover in Germany and Sharjah in the United Arab Emirates, a senior company official said on Tuesday.
Flights to Hanover will start on May 14, and to Sharjah on May 31, Valentin Nerodyuk, company vice president, told Reuters.

Flights to Hanover will be every Wednesday, and to Sharjah on Wednesdays and Saturdays. Both routes will be served by Tupolev Tu-154 airplanes. Typically the Tu-154 has single class seating for about 160 with a maximum payload of 46.5 tonnes.
Until recently the national company made only charter flights to the United Arab Emirates. As for Germany, regular flights went only to Frankfurt.

Kyrgyzstan Abu Zholdoru currently makes regular flights to 24 destinations in India, China, Turkey, Germany, Malaysia, Thailand, Britain and to 17 in the former Soviet Union. - Almaty Newsroom, +7 3272 509410
